simple.summary: סֵעֵף (çêʻêph) means divided (in mind), i.e. (concretely) a skeptic First listed occurrence: Ps 119 113.

definitions.full: H5588. seeph II. [ סֵעֵף ] (Kö ii. 106 ) adjective divided, half hearted ; — plural absolute as substantive, in religious sense, שָׂנֵאתִי סֵעֲפִים Psa 119:113 half-hearted ones do I hate .
